name: codex-sidebar-keeper
description: A Codex++ user script and Codex personal plugin that keeps the Codex Desktop right-side work panel open.

interface.shortDescription: Keeps the Codex right-side work panel open.
interface.longDescription: Codex Sidebar Keeper keeps the Codex Desktop right-side work panel open after switching conversations, can prefer side chat, browser, or terminal, and can keep only one right-panel tab while preserving the current main conversation.
defaultPrompt: Install the Codex++ sidebar keeper user script.
Reload the Codex++ sidebar keeper user script.
Help me set the preferred right-side panel target.
Help me keep only one Codex right-panel tab.
